SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) exp_ids, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) keys, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) consent_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) in_holdout,
 min(contact_ts_utc) mn, max(contact_ts_utc) mx,
 count(DISTINCT e.contact_channel) chans, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) orphan
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id=e.campaign_id AND h.member_id=m.member_id
WHERE e.campaign_id=19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.return_flag_dummy
  FROM (SELECT *, 0 AS return_flag_dummy FROM fact_sales_line) f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id=m.member_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND ((s.store_id=900 AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
      OR (s.store_id<>900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) targeted_members, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT member_id) buyers,
 sum(net_amount) net_before_returns, sum(gross_amount) gross_incl_vat,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale_date
FROM lines

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, s.store_id, p.category, m.member_id,
         w.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id=m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05')
SELECT 'dup receipt+line' k, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) v, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) amt FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines by status/in-window', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM base WHERE store_id=900 AND status IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web '||coalesce(status,'null')||' dispatch_in_window='||coalesce(CAST(dd BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AS VARCHAR),'null'), count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM base WHERE store_id=900 GROUP BY status, (dd BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
UNION ALL SELECT 'store 999/ZZ in order-date window', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM base WHERE (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test') AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'store lines in window', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM base WHERE store_id<900 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND category<>'ZZ Test'

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.join_date > DATE '2026-05-04' THEN m.member_id END) joined_after_start,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', e.contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN m.member_id END) contact_outside_window,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(e.contact_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to) THEN m.member_id END) version_mismatch,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) delivered_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure x WHERE x.campaign_id=19) exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT campaign_id, member_key, contact_channel, contact_ts_utc FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19 GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_contacts
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
WHERE e.campaign_id=19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_name = 'Spring Garden Launch 2026')
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
spend AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND(net_spend, 2) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat_before_returns
FROM spend
